system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
Each agent is a self-contained markdown playbook (`## User Prompt` methodology +
`## System Prompt` strict anti-false-positive rules).
system_prompt_style.note: Per-agent markdown system prompts loaded at runtime; objective/scope steer every agent prompt.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: recons the target, **intelligently selects only the agents that match the discovered surface**, runs them in parallel, **chains** findings into deeper
env_context_strategy.note: Pentest domain: harness recons/explores the target then selects agents; no injected file tree or retrieval described. Single-valued.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
agents capture visual proof per finding
(`evidence/<finding-id>-N.png`), embedded beside its vulnerability
observation_format.note: Empirical raw tool output is the primary observation; screenshots captured as proof.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
the harness runs a
**real** request/response analysis
tool_call_format.note: Agents drive CLI tools (curl/nmap/aws/gcloud/az); exact call format not shown in README.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
can
emit a repro PoC to `pocs/`
edit_primitive.note: No target-file edit primitive; agents write PoC scripts to pocs/ but do not edit a codebase.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Each agent is a self-contained markdown playbook
tool_schema_source.note: Agent playbooks are hand-authored markdown; underlying tool schema source not shown.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Enable Playwright MCP (auto-provisioned via `npx`; backends without MCP use built-in tools).

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
target ─▶ recon (curl/nmap/…) ─▶ INTELLIGENT agent selection (recon-aware)
─▶ parallel exploitation ─▶ cross-model validation vote
loop_primitives.note: Fixed recon→select→exploit→vote→report pipeline; multi-model voting jury; attacker→judge loops.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
a property-graph **belief** carries probabilities,
and "scan more vs exploit now" falls out of belief entropy
planning_granularity.note: POMDP belief drives decisions but no stored plan object/task list described.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
intelligently selects only the agents that match the
discovered surface**, runs them in parallel
multi_agent_topology.note: meta/orchestrator.md selects and runs specialist agents in parallel.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
runs them in parallel, **chains** findings into deeper
impact

human_in_loop.note: TUI composer lets a human pause/steer during the run; Ctrl-C prompts report or discard.

short_term_state.note: Belief property-graph plus findings.json maintained beyond messages.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote:
A reinforcement-learning reward store (`data/rl_state_rs.json`) biases agent
selection on future runs.
long_term_memory.note: Per-project .neurosploit/ session/run/command history plus RL state across runs.

state_persistence.note: Also: an in-progress web run reattaches to the same live stream.

self_verification.evidence_quote: a different model adjudicates each finding
self_verification.note: Cross-model voting jury + false_positive_filter/exploit_validator meta agents.

retry_policy.note: Voting adjudicates findings; no whole-task retry loop described.

rollback.evidence_quote:
strictly non-destructive (no data loss, no DB
overwrite, no DoS)
rollback.note: No rollback mechanism described; actions are non-destructive by policy.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Cap agents run (`0` = all matching the recon).
termination_condition.note: --max-agents caps agents; run ends when pipeline completes and report is generated.

cost_controls.note: Cost/token telemetry reported but no enforced budget/routing/caching described; multi-model list is failover, not cost-based routing.

timeouts.note: No timeout mechanism described in README.

execution_isolation.note: Runs as a local compiled binary on host (Kali recommended); Kali Docker image optional.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote:
**Recommended: run on Kali Linux** (or the
Kali Docker image) so the offensive tools the agents use are already present
filesystem_access.note: Runs on host with full filesystem access.

network_policy.evidence_quote:
turns a URL, a source repository, a running app, or a host/IP into
an autonomous security engagement
network_policy.note: Network egress required for live exploitation; no restriction described.

permission_model.evidence_quote:
Agents are instructed to stay in scope, never run
destructive/DoS actions
permission_model.note: Out-of-scope/objective steer prompts but not enforced authorization gate on each call.

tracing.note: Per-run folder with status.json, recon.json, findings.json and transcripts.

replayability.note: Resume/reattach supported; also a replay_attack_specialist agent; not bit-for-bit.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Exercise the full pipeline without calling any model.
eval_hooks.note: Offline self-test only; no benchmark evaluation runner shipped.

guardrails.evidence_quote:
all
under a strict **data-safety/PII guardrail** (no destructive/state-changing
actions; PII proven with a masked sample, never dumped)
guardrails.note: Non-destructive action policy plus PII masking (output filter).

target_domain.evidence_quote:
reviews a
pull request, and on a confirmed finding at/above the threshold it **fails the
check
target_domain.note: Penetration testing (other) across web/black-box, white-box source review (swe/PR gate), cloud/host.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
drives a **pool of
LLMs** — via **API key** or local **subscription**
